paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, comparing the proportions of various sources. The chart is divided into 13 slices, each representing a different data source. The slices are labeled with their corresponding names and percentages, and are colored differently, although the exact shades are not specified. The largest slice, labeled "NQ" and colored blue, accounts for approximately 31.3% of the total. Other significant slices include "FEVER" (16.1%, orange), "SNLI" (15.4%, teal), and "VITAMINC" (13.0%, light blue), while smaller slices include "SCIFACT" (0.1%, grey), "PUBHEALTH" (0.5%, green), and "MULTIFC" (0.5%, pink). The chart does not include a legend, but instead labels each slice directly with its name and percentage. The slices are arranged in a somewhat descending order of size, although not perfectly so. Overall, the chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative proportions of different data sources in the combined training set.
